Radio telescopes are crucial for astronomical observations. Which one of these well-known
radio telescopes has the largest parabolic antenna?
Which is the least likely cause of death?

options.A: Being hit in the head by a bullet.
options.B: Being hit by a small meteorite.
options.C: Starvation during global winter caused by a major impact.
options.D: Driving while intoxicated without wearing seatbelts.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - Being hit by a small meteorite.

questions.stem_text:
Jupiter and the other jovian planets are sometimes called "gas giants." In what sense is
this term misleading?

options.A: The materials they are made of are not normally gaseous in everyday experience.
options.B: They actually contain a significant fraction of non-gaseous matter.
options.C: The materials that make up these planets are primarily in the form of a plasma not a gas.
options.D: Actually it's a great description because these worlds are big and gaseous throughout.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: B - They actually contain a significant fraction of non-gaseous matter.

questions.stem_text:
Which of the following lists the ingredients of the solar nebula from highest to lowest
percentage of mass in the nebula?

options.A: hydrogen compounds (H 2 O CH 4 NH 3) light gases (H He) metals rocks
options.B: hydrogen compounds (H 2 O CH 4 NH 3) light gases (H He) rocks metals
options.C: light gases (H He) hydrogen compounds (H 2 O CH 4 NH 3) metals rocks
options.D: light gases (H He) hydrogen compounds (H 2 O CH 4 NH 3) rocks metals

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - light gases (H He) hydrogen compounds (H 2 O CH 4 NH 3) rocks metals
